Niche diye gaye email ko padho aur analyze karo. Mujhe sirf aur sirf valid JSON format mein output chahiye (koi aur text nahi). JSON mein ye 3 keys honi chahiye:

"category": (Inquiry, Complaint, ya Other)

"sentiment": (Positive, Negative, ya Neutral)

"draft_reply": (Email ka ek professional reply)

Email Content: {{1.fullTextBody}}
